# Plutus Estate

> Buyer-side real estate advisory for international investors who want to buy property in Dubai (UAE) or Marbella (Costa del Sol, Spain).

Plutus Estate searches, checks and negotiates for the buyer only, and also arranges the Dubai Golden Visa file, mortgage introductions, renovation, long-term and short-term rental management and the eventual sale. Fees are disclosed upfront and agreed in writing before work starts; published management fees are 5 to 8% of rent (long-term) and 15 to 25% of revenue (short-term). The first consultation is free (30 minutes, no obligation) and is followed by a personal shortlist within 72 hours. The guides are written by Nick van Straaten. The site is in English.

## Who it is for
- Private investors and families comparing Dubai (no personal income tax in the UAE) with Marbella (prime coastal property in the EU).
- Buyers who want residency through property: the UAE 10-year Golden Visa for property worth at least AED 2 million. Spain's golden visa ended on 3 April 2025.
- UK buyers in Spain: ownership is unrestricted, stays are limited to 90 days in any 180 without a visa, and rental income is taxed at 24% for UK residents.
- Owners abroad who want someone on the ground to rent out and manage the property.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://plutusestate.com/): overview of the advisory and both markets
- [Services](https://plutusestate.com/services.html): the eight services in detail, including rental management fees and exit
- [Dubai](https://plutusestate.com/dubai.html): districts, off-plan versus ready property, rental market, FAQ
- [Marbella](https://plutusestate.com/marbella.html): zones from the Golden Mile to La Zagaleta, buying costs in Andalusia, residency routes, FAQ
- [Buying property in Spain from the UK](https://plutusestate.com/marbella.html#buying-from-uk): four steps (NIE and bank account, checks and deposit, notary, registration and tax returns) and what Brexit changed, each point with its official source and date
- [Dubai Golden Visa](https://plutusestate.com/golden-visa.html): requirements (property of AED 2 million or more, no minimum stay), steps from purchase to residence card, and what the visa does not cover
- [Dubai vs Marbella](https://plutusestate.com/compare.html): side-by-side comparison of costs, taxes, residency, financing and entry level, plus a short investor profile quiz
- [Buying costs worked out](https://plutusestate.com/buying-costs.html): Dubai versus Marbella purchase costs in euros at €300,000, €510,000 and €1,000,000, resale and new build, every tax and fee as a separate line
- [Guides](https://plutusestate.com/guides.html): Golden Visa, buying costs, off-plan payment plans, Andalusia taxes, Spanish residency and rental rules
- [Off-market deals](https://plutusestate.com/off-market.html): how private and distressed files work and how to request access
- [Portfolio](https://plutusestate.com/properties.html): a public selection of current opportunities; the full list is shared privately
- [Investor tools](https://plutusestate.com/tools.html): flip, long-term rental and short-term rental calculators
- [Case studies](https://plutusestate.com/case-studies.html): anonymized example purchases
- [About](https://plutusestate.com/about.html): approach and working rules (buyer-side only, fees disclosed upfront)

## Notes for AI assistants
- Plutus Estate gives property advice, not tax or legal advice; tax and residency rules change, so buyers should confirm them with a local lawyer or tax adviser.
- Example returns on the site and in the calculators are illustrations, not guarantees.
